steps: 1. ViTPose shoulder+hip keypoints -> torso crop (NOT full bbox)
2. Legibility classifier: skip unreadable frames (save compute)
3. PARSeq STR (NOT EasyOCR) for digit recognition
5. Tracklet-level log-likelihood aggregation over ALL legible frames
6. Roster constraint: reject numbers not in roster
key_insight: Single frame OCR ceiling is 80%. But tracklet voting over 15+ frames makes effective accuracy 99%+. Do NOT optimize single-frame OCR. Optimize vote aggregation.
vitpose_crop: Use YOLOv8-pose shoulder(5,6) and hip(11,12) keypoints to crop torso region. This is MUCH better than full bbox for OCR.
